title: ICC Docket 26-0169 — Order - Final: Final Order
text:
STATE OF ILLINOIS 

ILLINOIS COMMERCE COMMISSION 

T.A. Electrical Contracting, Inc. 

: 

: 
Application for Certification to Install, 
: 
26-0169 
Maintain or Repair Electric Vehicle 

: 
Charging Station Facilities under Section 
: 
16-128A of the Public Utilities Act. 

: 

ORDER 

By the Commission: 
I. 
INTRODUCTION 
On March 3, 2026, T.A. Electrical Contracting, Inc. (“Applicant”) filed a verified 
Application with the Illinois Commerce Commission (“Commission”) seeking a certificate 
of authority to install, maintain or repair electric vehicle charging stations in the State of 
Illinois under Section 16-128A of the Public Utilities Act (“Act”). 220 ILCS 5/16-128A. 
Applicant filed an Amended Application on May 4, 2026. Commission Staff (“Staff”) filed 
its Certified Statement on May 7, 2026, recommending that the Commission grant the 
certificate of service authority. The Administrative Law Judge issued rulings on May 8, 
2026 and May 27, 2026. In response to those rulings, Applicant filed Amended 
Applications on May 26, 2026 and June 11, 2026. Since all of the information to grant 
the requested relief was contained in the Application, the Administrative Law Judge 
waived the hearing in this matter, admitted Staff’s Certified Statement into the record, and 
marked the record “Heard and Taken.” 
II. 
REQUIREMENTS FOR ALL APPLICANTS UNDER SECTION 16-128A OF THE 
ACT 

Applicant has provided all pertinent contact information for itself as well as those 
persons or entities responsible for issues related to processing of the Application and 
Applicant’s applicable federal employer identification number or taxpayer identification 
number as required by Section 469.40 of the Commission’s rules. 83 Ill. Adm. Code 
469.40. Applicant also agrees to comply with informational and reporting requirements 
established in Section 469.50. In addition, Applicant agrees to accept service by 
electronic means as provided under the Commission’s Rules of Practice, 83 Ill. Adm. 
Code 200.1050. The Application includes the following information regarding the person 
who will perform or directly supervise installation to satisfy the requirements of Section 
469.40(f): 
1. 
A copy of the certification of satisfactory completion of the relevant training 
programs; and/or 

26-0169 
2 
2. 
An Affidavit by each qualifying person attesting to having satisfactorily 
completed at least five (5) installations of electric vehicle charging stations. 
III. 
CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS UNDER SECTION 469.50 

Applicant is required by Section 469.50 of the Commission’s rules to certify that it 
meets the following five (5) requirements: 
a) 
It will remain in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations and 
Commission rules and orders, including, but not limited to, the requirements 
of Sections 16-128(a) and 16-128A of the Act and Section 469. 
b) 
It will ensure that its employees, agents or contractors that install, maintain 
or repair electric vehicle charging stations or the employees, agents or 
contractors of any entity, agent or contractor with which it has contracted to 
perform those functions within the State of Illinois, shall: 
1) 
Comply with applicable building and electrical codes, including those 
contained in the National Electric Code; 
2) 
Comply with the electric vehicle charging station manufacturer’s 
installation, maintenance and repair instructions; 
3) 
Install only electric vehicle charging stations that meet the standards 
UL2202 – Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging System Equipment, 
UL2231-1 – Personnel Protection Systems for Electric Vehicle (EV) 
Supply Circuits: General Requirements, UL2231-2 – Personnel 
Protection Systems for Electric Vehicle (EV) Supply Circuits: 
Particular Requirements for Protection Devices for Use in Charging 
System and UL2594 – Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment, 
developed by the Underwriters Laboratory, 333 Pfingsten Road, 
Northbrook IL 60062; 
4) 
Ensure that all installer, maintainer or repairer obligations required 
under this Part and Sections 16-128(a) and 16-128A of the Act are 
met prior to the placing into, or returning into, use any electric vehicle 
charging station that the certificate holder installed, maintained or 
repaired; and 
5) 
Submit notifications to the servicing electric utility in accordance with 
the requirements specified in the applicable tariffs of the servicing 
electric utility, Section 16-128A of the Act, and this Part. 
c) 
It will comply with applicable municipal licensing and bonding requirements 
to do business in the State of Illinois. 
d) 
It will ensure that every installation, maintenance and repair of an electric 
vehicle charging station will be performed only by: 
1) 
A qualified person; or 

26-0169 
3 
2) 
An electrical contractor who is licensed in at least one municipality in 
the State of Illinois who is not a qualified person, provided he/she is 
directly supervised by a qualified person; or 
3) 
A person who is enrolled in a training program that, upon satisfactory 
completion, will meet the requirement to become a qualified person 
provided he/she is directly supervised by a qualified person. 
e) 
It affirms that it is licensed to do business in the State of Illinois. 
IV. 
CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES AND CONSUMER COMPLAINTS 
Applicant states it is not certified or licensed to install, maintain or repair electric 
vehicle charging station facilities in any other state. Applicant also declares it has not 
received consumer complaints in any state in the last five years. 
V. 
COMMISSION CONCLUSION AND CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE AUTHORITY 

The Commission has reviewed the Application, Amended Applications, and 
attachments provided by Applicant and finds that Applicant sufficiently demonstrates 
compliance with the requirements of the Act and Part 469. Staff recommends that the 
Commission grant the Application. The Commission concludes, therefore, that 
Applicant’s request for a certificate of service authority to operate as an Installer, 
Maintainer or Repairer of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations in Illinois should be granted 
and should include the following authority: 
CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE AUTHORITY 

IT IS CERTIFIED that T.A. Electrical Contracting, Inc. 
is granted service authority to operate as an Installer, 
Maintainer or Repairer of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations 
in the State of Illinois. 
VI. 
FINDINGS AND ORDERING PARAGRAPHS 

The Commission, having reviewed the entire record, is of the opinion and finds 
that: 
(1) 
T.A. Electrical Contracting, Inc. is authorized to transact business in Illinois 
and seeks a certificate of service authority to operate as an Installer, 
Maintainer or Repairer of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations under Section 
16-128A of the Act; 
(2) 
the Commission has jurisdiction over the party hereto and the subject matter 
hereof; 
(3) 
the recitals of fact and conclusions reached in the prefatory portion of this 
Order are supported by the record and are hereby adopted as findings of 
fact; 
(4) 
Applicant has demonstrated that it possesses sufficient certification and 
experience to provide services as an Installer, Maintainer or Repairer of 
Electric Vehicle Charging Stations in the State of Illinois; 
(5) 
Applicant has complied with Section 16-128A of the Act and Part 469; 

26-0169 
4 
(6) 
Applicant is not certified or licensed to install, maintain and/or repair electric 
vehicle charging station facilities in any other state and has not been the 
subject of any consumer complaints in any state; and 
(7) 
Applicant should be granted a certificate of service authority to operate as 
an Installer, Maintainer or Repairer of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations as 
specified in this Order. 

IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED by the Illinois Commerce Commission that T.A. 
Electrical Contracting, Inc. is hereby granted a Certificate of Service Authority authorizing 
it to operate as an Installer, Maintainer or Repairer of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations; 
said Certificate of Service Authority shall read as that set forth in Section V of this Order. 
IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that Applicant shall comply with the recertification 
requirements in 83 Ill. Adm. Code 469.70. 

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that Applicant shall comply with all applicable 
Commission rules and orders now and as hereafter amended. 
IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that pursuant to Section 10-113(a) of the Public 
Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, any application for rehearing shall be filed 
within 30 days after service of the Order on the party. 

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that, subject to the provisions of Section 10-113 of the 
Public Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, this Order is final; it is not subject to 
the Administrative Review Law. 

By Order of the Commission this 1st day of July, 2026. 

(SIGNED) DOUGLAS P. SCOTT 

Chairman
